description:
Psicóloga | Analista de RH | Gente e Gestão | Recrutamento e Seleção | Trinks

A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.

Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:

  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.

O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:

  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).

Será um diferencial se você conhecer:

  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento: PDI, Capacitações, Feedbacks, Desconto com Faculdades e Cursos de Idiomas;

Bônus por indicação de talentos;

Day off de aniversário e tempo de casa.

♿Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Na Trinks, valorizamos a melhor versão de você mesmo, com incentivos e autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias.

E aí, se identificou? Então vem com a gente impulsionar e conectar os negócios de beleza

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Company Overview


If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!


Role Summary


The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. The FST offers real‑time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites, providing world‑class service and creating lasting competitive advantage.


Responsibilities



  • Perform direct, in‑person service calls in response to customer requests.

  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly.

  • Work side‑by‑side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required.

  • Supervise the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly.

  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule.

  • Check equipment before commissioning and start‑up and evaluate performance during and after start‑up.

  • Monitor the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment.

  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products.

  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering.

  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged.

  • Other duties as assigned.


Requirements



  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT.

  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry.

  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.

  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference.

  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges.

  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.

  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills.

  • Intermediate English.

  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job.

  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods.

  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers.

  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.


Desirable Skills



  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable.

  • Professional certifications in this area.


About Flowserve


Flowserve is a world‑leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges itself to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.


Equal Employment Opportunity


EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co‑workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access flowserv.careers.com as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to In order to quickly respond to your request, please use the words "Accommodation Request" as your subject line of your email. For more information, read the Accessibility Process.

  • Criar experiências de marca inesquecíveis , conectando todos os pontos da jornada omnichannel do consumidor - dos bares mais exclusivos aos eventos mais influentes.
  • Gerir contas de alto prestígio , como bares sofisticados e restaurantes emblemáticos, além de identificar novas oportunidades que elevem o portfólio de luxo da Diageo.

  • Trabalhar lado a lado com os times de Cultura, Advocacy, Digital e Mídia , cocriando planos de execução de marca que traduzam o luxo sob a ótica do consumidor moderno.
  • Ser o(a) guardiã(o) da excelência na execução , garantindo que cada ponto de contato com o shopper reflita a sofisticação e o posicionamento das marcas de luxo.
  • Atuar em parceria com o Trade Marketing , você desenvolverá materiais e ativações sob medida para cada conta, incluindo treinamentos de equipe, gestão de back bar, impressão de menus e merchandising de alto padrão.

  • Desenvolver planos de ativação com foco em advocacy , em parceria com os times de Marketing e Cultura, fortalecendo o vínculo emocional entre marca e consumidor.
  • Estabelecer e manterá os padrões de ativação de luxo , garantindo consistência, inovação e excelência em cada execução.

O que esperamos?

  • Conhecimento dos lugares certos e das pessoas certas , com habilidade para construir relações sólidas com influenciadores-chave da indústria, conectando marcas de luxo aos ambientes onde elas realmente fazem a diferença.
  • Entendimento do consumidor de luxo , reconhecendo perfis, atitudes e tendências, e habilidade para traduzir esses insights em ações que geram conexão emocional e fidelidade.
  • Domínio da jornada omnichannel do consumidor , com capacidade de criar experiências integradas e memoráveis em múltiplos pontos de contato - do bar ao digital.
  • Perfil comercial com olhar curador , capaz de identificar oportunidades de negócio em contas icônicas e elevar o portfólio de luxo com propostas de valor diferenciadas.
  • Mentalidade voltada à experiência , com foco em aumentar reconhecimento, experimentação e afinidade com as marcas por meio de ativações de alto padrão.
  • Habilidade de colaboração multidisciplinar , trabalhando de forma integrada com os times de Cultura, Advocacy, Digital, Mídia e Marketing para cocriar planos de execução que traduzam o luxo sob a ótica do consumidor moderno.
  • Excelência operacional , com atenção aos detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade em cada execução - seja em treinamentos, materiais de merchandising ou gestão de back bar.
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em performance , colaborando com o time Comercial para definir prioridades, contas estratégicas e ações que impulsionem resultados no on-trade.
  • Conhecimento em ativação de marca e advocacy , com habilidade para fortalecer o vínculo emocional entre consumidor e marca por meio de experiências autênticas e relevantes.
  • Compromisso com a consistência e inovação , mantendo os padrões de ativação de luxo sempre atualizados e alinhados às melhores práticas globais.
  • Comunicação com impacto , demonstrando habilidades de comunicação refinadas, capazes de influenciar, inspirar e engajar parceiros estratégicos e equipes internas.
  • Sede de fazer acontecer , com motivação por resultados e com energia para criar experiências memoráveis nos principais eventos e contas Top Luxury Accounts (TLA) da cidade.
  • CNH B em dia.

A flexibilidade é a chave para o nosso sucesso. De meio período e horas compactadas a diferentes locais, nosso pessoal trabalha de forma flexível de maneiras adequadas a eles. Fale conosco sobre o que a flexibilidade significa para você, para que você seja apoiado desde o primeiro dia.

Abraçamos a diversidade no sentido mais amplo possível. Isso significa que você será bem-vindo e celebrado por quem você é apenas por ser você. Junte-se a nós e ajude a transformar nossos negócios à medida que levamos nossas marcas para o próximo nível e construímos novas como parte da formação da próxima geração de celebrações para consumidores em todo o mundo.

No Grupo Trigo , a gente leva a sério a missão de conquistar corações através do estômago! Somos uma das maiores redes de franquias do Brasil, a turma por trás de marcas como Spoleto, Koni, Gendai, China in Box, Le Bonton, Gurumê e 2V Deli & Conveniência. A empresa nasceu com o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária e está crescendo rapidamente.

Se você curte um ambiente descontraído, ama inovação e aprender coisas novas, o Grupo Trigo é o seu lugar ! Estamos em busca de uma pessoa analítica, curiosa e orientada por dados , que atue no cruzamento entre CRM e Performance , transformando informações em insights acionáveis que guiem decisões estratégicas e potencializem resultados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no cruzamento entre CRM e Performance, transformando informações em insights acionáveis que orientem decisões estratégicas;
  • Trabalhar com múltiplas marcas e diferentes jornadas de cliente, aplicando raciocínio analítico e criatividade na solução de problemas;
  • Contar histórias com dados, conectando métricas a resultados de negócio e apoiando o time na tomada de decisões mais inteligentes;
  • Desenvolver e manter segmentações avançadas, relatórios e dashboards com foco em insights estratégicos para CRM;
  • Transformar dados em ações: identificar oportunidades, sugerir hipóteses, testar, medir e acompanhar resultados das iniciativas;
  • Consolidar dados de diferentes fontes (app, loja, delivery, fidelidade, CRM, campanhas) para análises integradas da jornada do cliente;
  • Conduzir análises de performance de campanhas, avaliando engajamento, retorno e indicadores-chave (retenção, frequência, ticket médio, LTV, churn);
  • Criar modelos preditivos e segmentações complexas com base em comportamento e propensão, otimizando campanhas e personalização;
  • Automatizar relatórios e processos analíticos, aumentando a eficiência e o acesso rápido a informações de negócio;
  • Comunicar insights de forma clara e visual, traduzindo análises em histórias que influenciem decisões estratégicas;
  • Colaborar em ambiente ágil e multimarcas com os times de Planejamento, CRM, Fidelidade, Mídia e Tecnologia;
  • Contribuir para a cultura data-driven do Grupo Trigo, estimulando o uso de dados no dia a dia das decisões de marketing e relacionamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de dados, indicadores e automação de relatórios;
  • Domínio em SQL, Power BI e Excel avançado, com habilidade para tratar e visualizar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Capacidade de estruturar análises e transformar resultados em recomendações práticas de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e com raciocínio lógico apurado;
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração em equipe e organização;
  • Interesse genuíno em aprendizado contínuo, inovação e cultura de dados.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Python (automação, análises preditivas ou machine learning);
  • Experiência prévia em CRM, e-commerce ou marketing de performance;
  • Vivência com modelos preditivos, como propensão à recompra, churn e lifetime value;
  • Experiência em testes A/B e metodologias de experimentação;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação de marketing e APIs de dados;
  • Entendimento de governança de dados, privacidade e segurança da informação (LGPD e GDPR).

R$ 1,00) + Vale Refeição / Vale Alimentação (R$32/dia) + GymPass + Plano de Saúde Amil + Plano Odontológico Amil + Auxílio Farmácia OMNI + Psicologia Viva + Convênio com Sesc + Convênio com faculdades + Convênio com cursos de idiomas + PLR + Trilha de Carreira!

title: Pessoa Técnica em Edificações | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura
description:
Pessoa Técnica em Edificações | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data‑driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Dentro da diretoria de Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura, a Fábrica de Cenários é a área responsável pela construção e entrega dos cenários que dão vida às produções de entretenimento, dramaturgia e eventos do Grupo Globo.

Reúne profissionais das mais diversas disciplinas — carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamentos e gestão técnica — que transformam projetos criativos em estruturas físicas com excelência técnica e artística.

Nosso desafio é equilibrar inovação, qualidade e velocidade de produção, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução, que integra arte, engenharia e tecnologia.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a execução de obras e montagens cenográficas, garantindo o cumprimento dos projetos, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar medições, levantamentos e controle de execução das etapas construtivas (carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamento, elétrica, etc.);
  • Realizar leitura de projetos, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos em projetos, assegurando a compatibilização entre os projetos de arquitetura, cenografia e infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar o time de orçamentos e suprimentos com informações técnicas e quantitativos de materiais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores e prestadores de serviços durante as etapas de produção e montagem, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança;
  • Contribuir para o controle de qualidade e atualização de padrões técnicos e construtivos da Fábrica;
  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas de Lean Construction e melhoria contínua nos processos produtivos.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação técnica completa em Edificações;
  • Experiência prévia em obras civis, cenográficas ou de estruturas temporárias;
  • Domínio com Projetos (leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas);
  • Conhecimento básico em medições, orçamentos e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Fábrica de Cenários e eventuais deslocamentos para estúdios e locações externas.
  • Conhecimento em Revit, SketchUp ou softwares 3D voltados à construção e cenografia;
  • Experiência em projetos de televisão, eventos, espetáculos ou produção de cenários;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Construction e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de equipes multidisciplinares e integração de disciplinas;
  • Curso complementa­rio em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Projetos.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link:

Ao prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos.

  • Participate in design reviews, offering constructive critique and feedback.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of UX/UI design experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating enterprise or technical product design.
  • Mastery of interaction and visual design; working knowledge of research methods.
  • Proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working with engineers in Agile environments (Angular/React familiarity preferred).

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Prior experience contributing to a design system.

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

A área é responsável pela geração de indicadores contábeis e financeiros, pelo gerenciamento de processos e controles contábeis, e pela gestão e auditoria das operações internacionais da Globo, com atuação nos escritórios de Londres, Nova York e Portugal. Também conduz a estruturação da informação contábil e realiza análises detalhadas de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, garantindo consistência e confiabilidade nos dados. Um dos principais desafios da área é assegurar qualidade, agilidade e profundidade analítica, por meio da aplicação de tecnologias avançadas, como Inteligência Artificial e Power BI, que potencializam a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar na área contábil, com foco em governança e analise de dados;
  • Garantir a qualidade das demonstrações financeiras, assegurando consistência e conformidade;
  • Realizar revisões analíticas, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Criar dashboards e indicadores, que apoiem a operação contábil e contribuam para a tomada de decisão.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC;
  • Experiência sólida na área contábil;

Sobre a empresa

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas de operação portuária e logística de acordo com os mais elevados padrões de qualidade e segurança, respeito ao indivíduo e ao meio ambiente, agregando máximo valor aos acionistas e à sociedade de forma ética e inovadora. Preocupados em primeiro lugar com a segurança em nossas atividades, focamos na união e no trabalho em equipe como meio de entrega. A Triunfo se dedica a uma gestão baseada em resultados, valorizando a performance, a iniciativa e a integridade de cada um. Inovar sempre, porque para nós, inovação é o melhor meio de apresentar resultados diferenciados ao mercado. Nós temos paixão e orgulho do que fazemos e estamos sempre dedicados a oferecer o melhor aos nossos clientes e colaboradores. Por isso, entregamos excelência em nosso trabalho.

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)

  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

description:
Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

  • Instructional Design: Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Instructional Design: Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Instructional Design: Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Team Leadership: Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Team Leadership: Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Project Management: Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Project Management: Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Project Management: Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Project Management: Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Project Management: Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • Project Management: The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un‑invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non‑funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month‑end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48‑hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi‑currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent

Fonction : Ingénieur scientifique contractuel

Contexte et atouts du poste

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km3) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’ objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP ) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

Mission confiée

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail : ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède,Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :
La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :
La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :
La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activités

Principales activés:

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d'autorisations d'absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)
  • Prestations sociales, culturelles et sportives (Association de gestion des œuvres sociales d'Inria)
  • Thème/Domaine : Sciences de la planète, de l'environnement et de l'énergie

Attention : Les candidatures doivent être déposées en ligne sur le site Inria. Le traitement des candidatures adressées par d'autres canaux n'est pas garanti.

Consignes pour postuler

Sécurité défense :
Ce poste est susceptible d’être affecté dans une zone à régime restrictif (ZRR), telle que définie dans le décret n° relatif à la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique de la nation (PPST). L’autorisation d’accès à une zone est délivrée par le chef d’établissement, après avis ministériel favorable, tel que défini dans l’arrêté du 03 juillet 2012, relatif à la PPST. Un avis ministériel défavorable pour un poste affecté dans une ZRR aurait pour conséquence l’annulation du recrutement.

Politique de recrutement :
Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, tous les postes Inria sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.

  • expérience en simulation numérique en mécanique des fluides

Inria est l’institut national de recherche dédié aux sciences et technologies du numérique. Il emploie 2600 personnes. Ses 215 équipes-projets agiles, en général communes avec des partenaires académiques, impliquent plus de 3900 scientifiques pour relever les défis du numérique, souvent à l’interface d’autres disciplines. L’institut fait appel à de nombreux talents dans plus d’une quarantaine de métiers différents. 900 personnels d’appui à la recherche et à l’innovation contribuent à faire émerger et grandir des projets scientifiques ou entrepreneuriaux qui impactent le monde. Inria travaille avec de nombreuses entreprises et a accompagné la création de plus de 200 start-up. L'institut s'eﬀorce ainsi de répondre aux enjeux de la transformation numérique de la science, de la société et de l'économie.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Manager, Customer Success Team
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

The Customer Success team here at Carta is a global team that is a key part of the broader VC Companies business unit. We manage the full lifecycle of our 33,000+ Private Markets customers, from early stage to IPO. Many of these companies drive the direction of our product and vision. This team is hyper‑focused on the health and growth of these valuable customers, and is purely dedicated to their success.

The Problems You’ll Solve

  • Provide leadership for CSM’s based in our Rio de Janeiro office by overseeing daily activities and tasks including renewal management, customer education, and other activities aimed at impacting the team’s NDR goals
  • Coach the team on CSM best practices and support them in their development as CSM’s
  • Guide your team through complex renewal negotiations, aligning nuanced customer factors with Carta business goal
  • Establish best practices for how to effectively manage a Customer Success team that leverages a scaled model, develop and implement new retention initiatives, strategies, and programs to help increase your team’s productivity
  • Partner with Customer Engagement Strategy and Operations to iterate on new and existing customer life cycle based content, campaigns, and playbooks
  • Act as an internal advisor, leader, and advocate for team members
  • Enable teams to educate customers in all segments on Carta’s broader mission of creating owners and liquidity
  • Work with Customer Success leadership to drive feedback on the growing requirements of all customers
  • Use Net Dollar Retention as the north star, aligning customers with their respective place in the journey to maximize relationships

The Impact You’ll Have

In this role, you will be directly impacting our Net Dollar Retention, by mitigating churn, affecting expansion, and setting up our early stage founders for success. The Customer Success team is responsible for driving successful outcomes for the installed base in its entirety and the Account Specialist Team is responsible for a significant portion of our client base.

About You

We’re looking for customer‑centric, organized professionals, who know how to work in a dynamic environment with multiple priorities based in our Rio de Janeiro office.

Cross‑departmental collaboration and communication is critical to success in the role, and efficient time management is essential as well. In addition, we’re prioritizing:

  • Currently based in Rio de Janeiro, BR and able to come into the office 3 days a week
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful customer management experience including renewal negotiations and minimum 2‑3 years of people management
  • Proven track record in customer success resulting in increased engagement and customer satisfaction that impacted retention and expansion
  • Strong operational discipline with an analytical, process‑oriented mindset and a data‑based approach to decision making
  • Resourceful and creative problem solving skills in order to provide optimal business or technical solutions
  • Customer‑first mindset, with a focus on seeking solutions to ensure greater lifetime value for our clients
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills along with an ability to work cross‑functionally with a broad range of internal and external clients
  • Self‑motivated, proactive team player with innovative ideas to inspire customer loyalty and adoption
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on building strong internal and external relationships
  • Proven ability to drive results, across multiple functions, and exceed allotted targets
  • Diplomacy, tact and poise under pressure, and a high tolerance for ambiguity
  • Growth mindset, proactive, and action‑oriented
  • Experience with CS software tools such as Salesforce, Catalyst, Chorus, Outreach, etc.

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.
  • Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta‑external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
Senior Software Test Designer

At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high‑tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting‑edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real‑world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth.

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities

  • Oversee the entire testing architecture/strategies, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing.
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and develop tools for qualification and integration.
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best results.
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment.
  • Review code and mentor junior engineers.
  • Share expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes.
  • Act as an advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspire others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Challenging and interesting projects in different domains.
  • Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues.
  • Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions.
  • Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy.
  • Tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • Contract for an indefinite period of time.
  • An all‑in employee benefit package (€61,000 – €85,000 annually): inclusive of competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance.
  • Good secondary employment conditions: e.g., 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme, relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • A good work‑life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working.
  • An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym.
  • The home office support package will turn your 'home office' into an inspiring environment.
  • Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar.
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high‑tech domain.
  • Capability to define and oversee the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
Corporate Recruiter at TOPIC Embedded Systems

At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high‑tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting‑edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?

“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”

Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems

What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.

Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware‑in‑the‑Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands‑on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan‑oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high‑tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all‑in benefits package (€62,000 – €82,000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support

This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work‑life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work‑from‑home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events

What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands‑on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan‑oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high‑tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System‑on‑Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

description:

Job Information

Reporting To: HSE Manager
Function: HSEQ
Location: Onshore

About Seadrill

Seadrill is one of the world’s most modern offshore deepwater drilling companies. Using ground-breaking technology, we operate in 15 countries across five continents, employing some 5,000 people representing 65 nationalities. Our vision is to set the standard in drilling. Our ambition is high and every single one of us has a part to play. Help us keep innovating, improving, and maintaining the highest safety standards, and we’ll give you what you need to be your best too.

We are safety-conscious, accountable, inspirational, loyal and proactive in all that we do and in every decision we make. Diversity and inclusion are more than words for us. Everyone is welcome—as an inclusive workplace, our people feel comfortable bringing their authentic, whole selves to work. We continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates diverse voices.

Job Summary

The overall objective of the role is to be a visible and engaged champion of Seadrill’s Task Process (PIMED – Plan, Identify, Manage, Execute & Debrief) to drive safe, efficient and reliable operations. The focus of the role is to support and verify the application of the Task Process and Seadrill’s safety tools; implementation of HSE requirements; rig operations via visible, proactive and engaged HSE coaching.

Job Specific Responsibilities

  • Promote Occupational Health & Wellbeing
    • Act as a visible safety leader.
    • Champion the HSE Pillars: PIMED, Seadrill Safe Actions, 5S, Human Factors, Environmental Stewardship.
    • Support the provision of health and wellbeing within area operations.
  • Major Accident Hazard (MAH) Management
    • Support the Area HSE Manager to ensure the Area Incident Management Plan (IMP) and AREA IMT are trained in response.
    • Monitor rig emergency response plans (ERPs) are known and drilled at rig and area level.
    • Maintain CIM for the IMT and ensure it is used correctly.
  • HSEQ Advice and Support
    • Provide consistent and accurate HSEQ advice to onshore and offshore management teams.
    • Produce regional HSEQ performance statistics, identify trends, and take proactive initiatives to improve performance.
  • Collaboration and Client Support
    • Attend client HSEQ forums and provide lessons learned feedback.
    • Ensure HSE bridging documents are in place and current.
    • Engage with HSE teams of customers and customer service providers.
  • HSEQ Communications & HSE Performance Monitoring
    • Produce and communicate HSEQ alerts following incident investigations and IRB to share lessons learned.
    • Support HSE performance data-led review of red rig recovery plans and actively support implementation of red rig recovery plans.
  • Incident Investigations
    • Ensure all events are reported correctly in Synergi.
    • Conduct HSE investigations in area, acting as lead investigator as required.
  • HSEQ Monitoring
    • Conduct regular rig visits to support rig management team and OHSEAs.
    • Monitor RVs and ODVs by OHSEAs to ensure quality verifications and timely closure of findings.
  • HSE Regulations
    • Maintain detailed knowledge of HSE regulatory requirements in the area of operations.
    • Participate in HSE regulatory audits and close‑out meetings.

Safety at Seadrill

Our goal is to ensure nobody gets hurt while performing their job. Everyone at Seadrill has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment. Through strong leadership and personal responsibility, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing hazards. Nothing is more important to us than the health, safety and security of our workforce and the communities in which we operate.

Seadrill Behavioral Framework

We co‑created our behavioural framework with employees. Four key competencies define our culture: Drive & Ownership, Change & Forward Thinking, Communication & Collaboration, Service Delivery.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in offshore HSE or 7 years’ experience in onshore HSE outside drilling.
  • Strong analytical skills and confident communication.
  • Team player who continually monitors and promotes core HSE processes.
  • Proficient in incident investigation and root‑cause identification.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Knowledge of industry initiatives (IADC, DROPS, HPOG).
  • Understanding of applicable HSE regulatory requirements.
  • Familiarity with flag–state and international regulations (ISM, IMO).

Governance and Career Progression

  • NEBOSH Diploma in OH&S or equivalent HSE certification.
  • Completion of Seadrill training matrix and competence matrices.
  • Participation on audit team with company auditor.
  • Identified on succession plan for promotion.
  • Active personal development plan.

Minimum Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • BOSIET, offshore survival training and other required training for assigned area.
  • NEBOSH International General Certificate in OH&S or equivalent.

Preferred

  • Higher education qualification in HSE/Engineering or risk management.
  • NEBOSH Diploma in OH&S or equivalent.
  • Ability to speak other languages.

Join Seadrill

We value our people and want to retain them. We offer a competitive package built around an attractive base salary and a range of benefits tailored to your location.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
